about.lead: Anyone can open an AI tool. Almost no one knows what to do with it.
paragraphs: That’s the gap we built EDSCRIPT to close. We take people who can press buttons and turn them into people who make the calls — the story decision, the frame, the cut, the brand move — that no model makes for you.
We don’t teach prompts. We teach the eye behind them. Every course we run, filmmaking, design, podcasting, marketing, is built on one rule: story and craft come first, AI comes second, always.
about.vision: A generation of creators who command AI the way a director commands a set. In charge of every shot, every call, every outcome.
about.mission: Train directors, not operators. Hand people the judgment to lead AI, not the dependency to follow it.

ai-filmmaking.name: AI Film Making
ai-filmmaking.headline: Direct a film where every shot is your decision, not the machine’s.
ai-filmmaking.card: Take one short film from idea to festival-ready cut. AI generates, animates and finishes the work, and you make every creative call.
overview: Anyone can type a prompt and get a beautiful frame. Very few people can get forty frames that belong to the same film. This program teaches the difference.

You build one short film across sixteen weeks, the way a director runs a real production: story first, then cast, look, shots, motion, sound and the edit. Each stage is locked before the next one begins, so nothing is generated until the decisions behind it are made.

AI enters at every stage, always after a human decision. You write the script before the machine sees it, and you design every character and reference before a single shot is generated. That discipline is what keeps an AI film consistent from the first frame to the last.

podcasting.name: Podcast Production
podcasting.headline: Plan, record and launch a podcast people actually finish.
podcasting.card: Design a show around a real listener, record a guest interview that sounds professional, edit it honestly, and publish it on every major platform.
overview: Most podcasts stop by episode three because they were started with a microphone, not a listener. This program begins with the person you are making the show for, then works backwards into format, voice, studio and edit.

Your capstone is a real guest-interview episode. You will learn to choose the right guest, design the conversation, handle it live when it takes an unexpected turn, and edit it so it stays true to what was said.

AI is used for specific jobs only: rehearsing the interview, checking a script or transcript, and drafting show notes. The judgment calls about what to ask, what to keep and what to cut stay with you.

digital-marketing.name: AI & Digital Marketing
digital-marketing.headline: Run marketing that can prove it worked, with AI in every part of the workflow.
digital-marketing.card: Go from brand truth to search, social, content, ads and email, then measure what actually moved the numbers, using generative AI as a working tool throughout.
overview: Most digital marketing courses teach channels one at a time: a week of SEO, a week of ads, a week of social. Real marketing does not work that way. This program follows one campaign from start to finish: what is true about the brand, how people discover it, what proves it works, how customers stay, and how it launches.

Generative AI is built into every stage, not added at the end. You use it for research, content, ad variations, automation and reporting, and you learn where human judgment still has to make the call.
The course also covers visibility in AI search tools such as ChatGPT and Gemini, alongside Google. That is where a growing share of discovery now happens.

brand-storytelling.name: Brand Storytelling
brand-storytelling.headline: Build a brand from its truth outward, and launch it for real.
brand-storytelling.card: Take a real brand through positioning, visual identity, voice, content and proof, then launch it live and defend the results.
overview: Most branding work starts with a logo. This program starts with the truth: who the customer really is, what problem they have, and what the brand actually competes against. Every later decision about the name, logo, colour, voice and content has to trace back to that truth. If it doesn’t, it’s decoration.

You work on one real brand throughout the course, usually your own venture or a real local business. You build it in five stages, Truth, Position, Shape, Voice and Signal, then test it in a sixth, Proof. In the final two weeks you launch it live, read the results honestly and defend them before a panel.

The case studies are Indian brands, including CRED, Zomato, Amul, Paper Boat, Zepto and Groww. AI supports research, visual exploration, copy and content planning, but every shippable logo and line is made by you.

content-creation.headline: Make short-form content people stop for, and build it into a system you can keep up.
content-creation.card: Plan, shoot, edit and publish content for Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn and more, with AI speeding up the work and a repeatable system behind it.
overview: Going viral once is luck. Showing up every week with content your audience recognises is a skill, and it is the skill this program teaches.

You start with who you are making content for and what you want them to feel. Then you learn the craft: the hook, the frame, the cut and the caption. Every piece you make is shot on a phone and published to a real account.

From there you build a content system: pillars, formats, a calendar and a workflow one person can actually keep up with. AI helps with ideas, scripting, editing and repurposing. The point of view, the taste and the final call stay with you.
